messages.en: Sorry to bother you. Are you busy? I just wanted to ask you something.
No worries, I've finished what I was working on. Go ahead.
My internet's acting up at home. Your voice keeps cutting out.
No worries, I'll just send you the notes on WhatsApp.
My mouse battery's dead. Are there any spare batteries at the office?
Yep, they're right in my drawer. Help yourself to two.
We've run out of cooking gas. Are you planning to cook tonight?
Yeah, I'm planning to cook. I'll order some gas now.
